categories.main_business_segments: Sailvan Times Co., Ltd. primarily operates in cross-border e-commerce with a focus on fashion lifestyle products. Its main product categories include apparel and accessories (covering menswear, womenswear, homewear, underwear, and children's clothing) and non-apparel categories such as sports and entertainment. The company also provides logistics services based on its cross-border warehousing and logistics system. It sells products mainly through third-party e-commerce platforms like Amazon and Walmart, as well as its own vertical category websites.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs a technology-driven business model with full-chain digital capabilities, including a proprietary fashion trend forecasting system, a flexible apparel supply chain system with digital and intelligent scheduling, and big data-driven procurement and logistics management. It integrates AI technologies for product development, marketing automation, and supply chain optimization. The apparel supply chain supports small batch, multi-variety, high-quality production to meet fast fashion demands, and the company has developed intelligent warehouse management and robotic scheduling systems to enhance logistics efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sailvan Times serves global consumers primarily through B2C e-commerce channels, with Amazon accounting for the majority of sales. Its key customers are individual consumers worldwide, especially in North America and Europe. The company also engages in B2B sales and provides logistics services to third parties. The main markets are North America (88.08% of revenue), Europe (6.88%), and Asia, with a growing presence on emerging platforms like Temu and TikTok Shop.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with a strong focus on North America and Europe. It has established subsidiaries and operations in China (headquarters in Shenzhen), the United States, Germany, Hong Kong, Vietnam, Canada, and other regions. The company is expanding its overseas supply chain, particularly in Southeast Asia, with production facilities and suppliers in Vietnam and logistics centers in the US and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sailvan Times operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It integrates product development, flexible manufacturing, brand incubation, and e-commerce sales. The company also manages cross-border warehousing and logistics, providing end-to-end supply chain services. It owns production facilities and collaborates with external suppliers, balancing in-house manufacturing and outsourced processing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes brand-driven globalization supported by digital and AI technologies. Key R&D initiatives include developing intelligent advertising operation platforms, AI-agent workflow engines, intelligent warehouse robotics, and full-industry-chain collaborative service platforms. It invests heavily in AI applications for marketing, supply chain, and customer service automation. The strategic focus is on accelerating brand matrix expansion, enhancing brand recognition, optimizing supply chains, and leveraging AI to improve operational efficiency and innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales on B2C e-commerce platforms (notably Amazon) and self-operated websites, accounting for over 90% of income. The company also earns revenue from B2B sales and logistics services, including warehousing and freight forwarding. Additional income sources include government subsidies, investment income from financial products, and asset disposals. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing models but focuses on direct sales and service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Sailvan Times positions itself as a leading Chinese cross-border e-commerce brand operator with a strong technology and supply chain foundation. It competes against global e-commerce platforms like Amazon and emerging players such as Temu, SHEIN, and TikTok Shop. The company differentiates through its full-chain digital capabilities, flexible supply chain, and brand matrix strategy. It holds a significant market share in niche apparel segments on Amazon and is recognized as a high-tech and digital trade leader in Guangdong Province.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Sailvan Times achieved total revenue of approximately RMB 10.28 billion, a 56.55% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 214 million, down 36.19% from the previous year. The company has shown rapid revenue growth driven by brand expansion and market penetration, especially in North America and Europe. Total assets reached RMB 4.74 billion, up 30.9% from 2023. The company maintains a stable equity base with net assets of RMB 2.46 billion and continues to invest significantly in R&D and supply chain infrastructure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sailvan Times offers high-quality, personalized fashion lifestyle products tailored to global consumer preferences through a technology-driven, agile brand matrix. Its competitive advantages include a proprietary digital platform enabling rapid trend analysis, flexible supply chain management for small-batch fast fashion, and AI-powered marketing and operational automation. The company emphasizes brand building with international recognition, such as participation in New York Fashion Week, and leverages data-driven insights to optimize product development and customer experience, differentiating itself in the competitive cross-border e-commerce market.
